In addition to robotics hardware, Sunday develops the underlying AI, computer vision, manipulation, and machine learning technologies that enable perception, navigation, and task execution. long_description: Suki is an AI-powered ambient clinical intelligence platform and voice assistant tailored for healthcare professionals. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Suki aims to reduce administrative burdens, automate documentation, and enhance clinical reasoning. The company has gained recognition as one of TIME’s Top HealthTech Companies of 2025 and has raised approximately $165 million in funding. The flagship product, Suki Assistant, captures clinician-patient conversations to generate comprehensive clinical notes and integrates seamlessly with Electronic Health Records (EHRs). Suki also offers ambient clinical intelligence for revenue cycle management and coding accuracy, along with Suki Compose for streamlined note creation. The platform supports over 100 medical specialties and is designed to assist clinicians in focusing more on patient care rather than administrative tasks. Suki serves over 400 health systems globally, partnering with major EHR vendors to enhance healthcare technology.

long_description: TARGAN builds high-speed imaging, AI and robotics systems for commercial hatcheries. Its WingScan system identifies chick sex from feathers at up to 100,000 chicks per hour, and its ocular spray system gives individualized vaccinations. Customers are poultry producers such as Wayne-Sanderson Farms. It has installed systems in the US, Canada, France, Italy and Poland and has processed over 2.5 billion chicks (2026). The company secured a $100M financing deal in early 2026, and Merck Animal Health announced plans to acquire it in June 2026.

long_description: Tacta Systems, Inc. is a robotics company based in Palo Alto, California, focused on Dextrous Intelligence, a unique "smart nervous system" that allows robots to perform delicate, human-like tasks with flexibility and precision. Founded in 2023 by experienced entrepreneurs, including CEO Andreas Bibl, the company is dedicated to advancing software, hardware, and AI technologies for robotic dexterity and manipulation. Tacta's main offering is its centralized robot intelligence platform, which combines various technologies to enable robots to interact with the physical world effectively. This platform allows for tasks that require dexterous manipulation and haptic sensing, providing robots with human-level adaptability and precision. The company is actively developing solutions for both industrial and consumer applications, addressing complex challenges in the robotics engineering industry.

long_description: Standard Bots develops industrial robotics systems that combine robotic hardware with AI-driven software to automate manufacturing and operational tasks. Its product portfolio includes collaborative robotic arms with different payload capacities, as well as software platforms that support robot programming, fleet management, and application development. The company’s technology enables users to teach robots through demonstration rather than relying solely on traditional coding methods, allowing robots to perform tasks such as machine tending, inspection, palletizing, welding, and material handling. Standard Bots also provides AI capabilities that allow robots to learn from observed actions, adapt to changes in their environment, and improve task execution over time. In addition to its robotic systems, the company offers operating software, development tools, and integration capabilities designed to support deployment across a range of industrial workflows.
